Sensa Signal Issue 18 · Jul 2026
Rendering Imagination

Three signals that real time took over this week

Photoreal moved to the roadmap, the engine behind the games paid out a billion, and gaming sold out its biggest room. Real time is the common thread.

01 Field notes

Neural rendering moved to the roadmap

NVIDIA's SIGGRAPH keynote put neural rendering, world models and AI driven simulation on the near term roadmap, not the research horizon. Photoreal environments that used to be a post production line item are becoming something you generate and change live.

See what shifts ›
02
In the lab

The engine that paid creators a billion

Epic teased Unreal Engine 6 and confirmed it has paid creators over 1 billion dollars through Unreal Editor for Fortnite, with iteration times down about 40 percent. The engine behind the games is the same one behind virtual production and live visuals.

Read the stack ›
03 Craft

Gamescom sold out for the first time

Gamescom 2026 reached full exhibition capacity for the first time ever, with organizers already planning to expand. It runs late August in Cologne and is expected to surpass every previous edition. Even payment brands are buying in.

See the scale ›
